title: a connector end reached through an import binds to the imported feature
note: FIXED 2026-09-03 (I4 review). The anchor walk materialises a usage-scoped mirror for an end reached through INHERITANCE, because a type-owned feature is shared by every usage of that type. It used to do so for any end the scope did not own itself — including one reached through `import Lib::*;`. A package inherits nothing, so there is no prototype to mirror: the mapper fabricated an implicit `P::x` plus a Redefinition and bound the connector to its own invention. An imported end is a real element the author named, and binds directly.
